producer.carrier: smooth big+A in-plane parametrization, explicitly not sheet estimate; n from smooth P; 20vox carrier grid
producer.z84_z84o_R1_L1_A_big: carrier.crossings creates g.Surf(up4) and cross(span60, default iters5/miss_max3), saves float32 t, discards miss
producer.z99: touchup.py lines24–28 uses separate g.Surf(up4).cross(span60), saves uncast float64 t; shipped cached file checksum matches author decision. Historical producer replay not independently established.
producer.local_equation: Q=P+t*n is a near-crossing proxy; |t|<=60 and miss<3 are producer code conditions, not independently measured error bounds on shipped data.

shared_dependencies: Author discovery says spiral fits were snapped to same m7 prediction; GrowPatches also use m7 and same CT. Separate constructions are not independent physical truth.
selection_caveat: METHOD section8 says ink on alternate right-end sheet had been viewed before adoption and tracing was used as no-harm check; code can omit ink while selection is not blind.
band_config: z8400/z8400o both8400–9900 (outer winding range differs); z9900 9900–11400; z6900 6900–8400 is listed but original w074 geometry/near-crossing samples are not in shipped inputs. Do not substitute z9900 for rendered-up in flipped frame.
eligible_support: Only existing saved finite samples count. Same-array-index pre/post reflatten mapping, intensity peak snapping, extrapolation over missing offsets and applying right-component95.5% rate are excluded.
